high_severity_items.summary: G7 agrees to a coordinated IEA-backed release of 100 million barrels of crude and diesel over four months, including a frontloaded diesel tranche, to ease severe supply-driven fuel price spikes. The move follows US threats to ban diesel exports and reflects constrained global supply from Middle East conflict and Russian export bans, with diesel tightness especially acute for haulage and agriculture. The announcement is a supply-side easing signal but geopolitical risk remains elevated, leaving fuel markets volatile.
high_severity_items.title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump export ban threat

high_severity_items.summary: Physical crude and diesel markets are tightening sharply, with Dated Brent above $120 even as ICE Brent slips, driven by Hormuz shipping disruptions and China's refined-product export ban. high_severity_items.title: Dated Brent Above $120 Signals a Serious Oil Squeeze
